definitions.gloss: purse snatching; bag snatching; snatch theft
definitions.explanation: The crime of grabbing someone's bag or belongings and running away, typically committed on the street. Also refers to the person who commits this crime.

examples.japanese: ひったくり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧。
examples.english: I was the victim of a purse snatching.

examples.japanese: ⟦バイク→バイク：05081_baiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧ひったくり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鞄|かばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}われた→奪う：01895_ubau⟧。
examples.english: A snatch thief on a motorcycle grabbed my bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ひったくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多発|たはつ}→多発：20508_tahatsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{鞄|かばん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{車道|しゃどう}→車道：03066_shadou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{反対側|はんたいがわ}→反対側：16780_hantaigawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ようにして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Snatch thefts are frequent in this area, so please carry your bag on the side away from the road.

notes:
USAGE:
Can refer to both the crime itself and the person committing it. Derived from the verb ⟦ひったくる→ひったくる：20297_hittakuru⟧ (to snatch away). A common street crime in urban areas, often committed by someone on a bicycle or motorcycle targeting pedestrians.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ひったくり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧ (to be a victim of snatching)
- ひったくり⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (snatch theft damage/victimization)
- ひったくり{犯|はん} (snatch thief — refers specifically to the criminal)
- ひったくり⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (snatch theft prevention)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スリ: pickpocketing — stealthily taking items from pockets or bags without the victim noticing
- ⟦{置|お}き{引|び}き→置き引き：21576_okibiki⟧: theft of unattended belongings — taking bags or items left momentarily
